groups.name: Laboratory
groups.summary: Tests on blood, urine, stool, swabs, tissue and other body fluids.

groups.name: Imaging
groups.summary: Pictures of the inside of the body.

groups.name: Specialty diagnostics
groups.summary: Recordings, functional tests, endoscopy and specialist examinations, organised by body system.

groups.name: Measurements, screening & procedures
groups.summary: Vital signs, validated assessment tools, diagnostic procedures and tests done at the bedside or at home.

categories.name: Blood & haematology
categories.summary: Counts and appearance of the cells in blood, haemoglobin and its variants, red-cell survival and the bone marrow that makes them.

categories.name: Coagulation & haemostasis
categories.summary: How well blood clots and how quickly clots are broken down: screening times, individual factors, platelet function and the inherited or acquired tendencies to bleed or clot.

reasons: fewer than two pages in the category

categories.name: Chemistry & metabolic
categories.summary: The salts, gases, proteins, enzymes, waste products and fuels measured in serum or plasma: the core chemistry of every hospital laboratory.

categories.name: Kidney & urinary
categories.summary: Blood and urine measurements of how well the kidneys filter, concentrate and conserve, and the dipstick and microscopy examination of urine.

categories.name: Liver & hepatobiliary
categories.summary: Enzymes, proteins and clotting factors that reflect liver-cell damage, bile flow and synthetic function, plus the antibody, viral, genetic and imaging tests of liver disease.

concepts.name: Prothrombin time and INR (liver synthetic function)

categories.name: Lipid & cardiometabolic
categories.summary: Cholesterol, triglycerides and the lipoproteins that carry them, with the newer markers used to refine cardiovascular risk.

categories.name: Diabetes & glucose
categories.summary: Glucose now, glucose over the last months, the insulin the pancreas makes and the antibodies that mark autoimmune diabetes.

categories.name: Endocrine & hormone
categories.summary: Hormones of the thyroid, adrenal, pituitary and parathyroid glands and the dynamic tests that provoke or suppress them.

categories.name: Reproductive & fertility
categories.summary: Sex hormones, ovarian reserve, semen analysis and the tests of ovulation used in fertility assessment.

categories.name: Pregnancy & prenatal
categories.summary: Confirming a pregnancy and, once established, the screening, diagnostic and monitoring tests of mother and fetus.

categories.name: Vitamins, minerals & nutrition
categories.summary: Iron and its carriers, the B vitamins, fat-soluble vitamins and trace elements: the deficiencies and excesses that show in blood.

categories.name: Immunology & inflammation
categories.summary: Markers of inflammation and infection, the complement system and the immunoglobulins that make up humoral immunity.

categories.name: Autoimmune & rheumatology
categories.summary: The autoantibodies and genetic markers used in lupus, rheumatoid arthritis, vasculitis, coeliac disease and autoimmune liver disease.

reasons: fewer than two pages in the category

categories.name: Allergy
categories.summary: Blood, skin and challenge tests that identify what a person reacts to and how severely.

reasons: fewer than two pages in the category

categories.name: Infectious disease & microbiology
categories.summary: Finding the organism: cultures, microscopy, antigen and antibody tests, PCR and sequencing for bacteria, viruses, fungi and parasites, and testing which drugs will work.

categories.name: Genetic & molecular
categories.summary: Tests of chromosomes, genes and variants, from a karyotype to whole-genome sequencing, and their use in inherited disease, cancer and drug response.

reasons: fewer than two pages in the category

categories.name: Cancer & tumour markers
categories.summary: Proteins and genetic changes measured in blood or tissue to help evaluate, stage, guide and monitor cancer. A marker alone rarely diagnoses cancer.

reasons: fewer than two pages in the category

categories.name: Toxicology & drug monitoring
categories.summary: Measuring medicines with a narrow safety margin, screening for drugs of misuse and detecting poisons, gases and heavy metals.

reasons: fewer than two pages in the category

categories.name: Pathology & cytology
categories.summary: Tissue and cells examined under the microscope: biopsies, smears, aspirates, special stains and the molecular tests done on them.

reasons: fewer than two pages in the category

categories.name: Blood bank & transfusion
categories.summary: Grouping, antibody screening and crossmatching so that transfused blood is compatible, and the tests of a suspected transfusion reaction.

reasons: fewer than two pages in the category

categories.name: Body fluid analysis
categories.summary: What is measured in cerebrospinal, pleural, ascitic, joint, pericardial and other fluids drawn from the body.

reasons: fewer than two pages in the category

categories.name: Imaging
categories.summary: X-ray, ultrasound, CT, MRI, nuclear medicine and bone densitometry: every way of making a picture of the inside of the body.

categories.name: Cardiovascular
categories.summary: Recordings, ultrasound, stress, catheter and vascular tests of the heart and blood vessels.

categories.name: Respiratory
categories.summary: How much air the lungs move, how well gas crosses into blood, and the challenge, exercise, sampling and endoscopic tests of the airways and lungs.

categories.name: Neurology
categories.summary: Recordings of the brain, nerves and muscles, tests of the spinal fluid and autonomic function, cognitive assessment and the imaging of the nervous system.

categories.name: Gastroenterology
categories.summary: Endoscopy, motility and acid studies, breath tests, liver assessment and the imaging of the digestive tract.

categories.name: Kidney & urology diagnostics
categories.summary: Imaging, endoscopy, pressure studies and biopsy of the kidneys, bladder and prostate, alongside the urine and blood tests of kidney function.

categories.name: Eye & ophthalmic
categories.summary: Tests of how well the eyes see and the examinations and imaging of every part of the eye.

reasons: fewer than two pages in the category

categories.name: Hearing & balance
categories.summary: Hearing thresholds, middle-ear and inner-ear function, and the tests that find the cause of dizziness and vertigo.

reasons: fewer than two pages in the category

categories.name: Sleep
categories.summary: Studies that record breathing, oxygen, brain activity and movement during sleep, and daytime tests of sleepiness.

reasons: fewer than two pages in the category

categories.name: Dermatology
categories.summary: Looking at, sampling and testing the skin: dermoscopy, biopsy, allergy patch tests, fungal tests and light-based examinations.

reasons: fewer than two pages in the category

categories.name: Bone, joint & musculoskeletal
categories.summary: Imaging of bones and joints, bone density, joint fluid, nerve and muscle studies and the blood tests of inflammatory and autoimmune joint disease.

categories.name: Vital signs & physiological measurements
categories.summary: The measurements taken at every consultation and hospital observation round, and what each reflects in the body.

categories.name: Screening & clinical assessment
categories.summary: Validated questionnaires and scores used to screen, grade severity and estimate risk. Proprietary instruments are described, never reproduced.

concepts.name: Wells score
synonyms: Wells criteria for DVT and PE

concepts.name: CHA2DS2-VASc score
synonyms: stroke risk score in atrial fibrillation

categories.name: Endoscopy & diagnostic procedures
categories.summary: Procedures done to look inside the body or take a sample: scopes of the airways, gut, bladder and joints, catheter studies, punctures and biopsies.

categories.name: Point-of-care & home testing
categories.summary: Tests done at the bedside, in a pharmacy or at home, with a meter, a strip or a self-collected sample.
